claims.subject: Claude Code
claims.label: documented
claims.claim: Claude Code is represented in this repository as an external CLI/session and native credential source that Jcode can interoperate with after explicit trust decisions.
claims.cooperation_boundary: Use Claude Code artifacts and credentials only through documented approval and takeover boundaries.
claims.limitations: This claim does not benchmark Claude Code quality or assert automatic credential access.

claims.subject: Codex
claims.label: documented
claims.claim: Codex/OpenAI appears as a provider lane in auth and provider-neutral orchestration planning.
claims.cooperation_boundary: Use as a peer provider behind auth, routing, and human approval gates rather than an automatic default.
claims.limitations: The inspected files contain less product-specific local-session detail for Codex than for Claude Code.

claims.subject: Pi
claims.label: inferred
claims.claim: Pi can only be presented as an advisory conversational surface in this repository-grounded comparison because no Pi-specific committed integration contract was found in the inspected files.
claims.cooperation_boundary: Keep Pi output advisory unless future committed evidence grants it tool or execution authority.
claims.limitations: No claims are made about Pi credentials, automated tooling, session import, or runtime performance.

claims.subject: Jcode
claims.label: documented
claims.claim: Jcode is the repository-native command center for this microsite work, combining local tools, static validation, evidence maps, auth boundaries, and swarm coordination surfaces.
claims.cooperation_boundary: Own local orchestration and validation while keeping risky auth, routing, and handoff mutations approval-gated.
claims.limitations: Evidence quality is bounded by committed or deliberately captured artifacts.

claims.subject: Cross-provider agents
claims.label: documented
claims.claim: Cross-provider coordination is documented as a way to route roles, compare outputs, and preserve evidence without allowing automated tournaments to mutate production routing by themselves.
claims.cooperation_boundary: Coordinate through shared artifacts, claim IDs, and explicit reports; require human approval for production routing or irreversible authority changes.
claims.limitations: This page does not assert a universal winner or quantify provider superiority.
